title: Run Event
description: Versioned orchestration event contract (v1). Long-running operations emit these into projects/<id>/events.jsonl via lib.events.emit_run_event / emit_heartbeat. The Backlot board renders progress, ETA and wait reasons from this stream. Field semantics: machine_ms = active machine time of this operation (excludes human wait); approval_wait_ms = time spent waiting on a human decision; retry_count = retries consumed for this attempt chain; cost_reservation_id = cost-tracker reservation for paid calls.

run_id.description: Stable id for one operation execution; same run_id across its queued/running/finished events.

attempt_id.description: Stable id of the attempt chain; unchanged across retries, changes when a new attempt series starts.

attempt.description: 1-based attempt number within the attempt chain.

stage.description: Pipeline stage this operation belongs to (research/idea/script/scene_plan/assets/edit/compose/publish).

operation.description: Machine operation name, e.g. remotion_render, tts_generate, scene_detect.

unit.description: Progress unit. kind=frame means current/total are frame numbers; percent means 0-100.

message.description: Human-readable one-liner (e.g. 'concurrency=1; retry after Chrome target closed').

eta_seconds.description: Best-effort remaining seconds; only render when a sane estimate exists.
